ux-ui-designer-digital-health.description: Produces interface structure, interaction states, and accessibility notes for digital health products, including error and unsafe-to-proceed states. Does not own research protocols, patient-programme journeys, or usability-test execution.
ux-ui-designer-digital-health.stops_quote: Flow-and-state drafts and accessibility issue lists may proceed. Patient-facing copy, clinical claims on screen, usability-engineering UI conclusions, and release of a regulated interface stop for the accountable owner. Protocol questions route to the UX Research Lead..
ux-ui-designer-digital-health.never_quote: WCAG or accessibility certification. IEC 62366 file sign-off. On-screen clinical, performance or adherence claims not bound to graded evidence. ... And treating a wireframe set as a completed usability-engineering user-interface specification.

service-design-director.description: Designs the care service a digital-health product sits inside ... Does not run usability studies and does not produce interface designs.
service-design-director.never_quote: Producing interface designs, interaction specs or UI copy as if they were service design. ... Substituting for the UX Research Lead on evidence of use, or for the UX designer on the interface.
service-design-director.routing_quote: Usability-evidence questions route to the UX Research Lead; interface questions route to the UX designer..
